sentences.text: A jingle is a short song or tune used in advertising and for other commercial uses .	short song or tune	fanfare	advertising	advertising

The jingle contains one or more hooks and meaning that explicitly promote the product or service being advertised , usually through the use of one or more advertising slogans .	advertising	advertising	hooks	hook (music)	slogans	slogans

Ad buyers use jingles in radio and television commercials ; they can also be used in non-advertising contexts to establish or maintain a brand image .	advertising	advertising	radio	radio	television commercials	television commercials
Jingles are a form of sound branding .	sound branding	sound branding

Many jingles are also created using snippets of popular songs , in which lyrics are modified to appropriately advertise the product or service .	snippets	sampling (music)	popular songs	popular music	lyrics	lyrics

causal_questions.question: Jingles are a form of sound branding used since the 1950s.
